activities.name: Mimizuku no Yu
activities.notes: Public bathhouse on the road from JR Hakuba Station to Happo with valley views of the Hakuba Sanzan. 10:00–21:00; tattoos generally accepted.

activities.name: Tenjin no Yu (Hakuba Himekawa Onsen)
activities.address: 21582 Hokujo, Hakuba-mura, Kitaazumi-gun, Nagano 399-9301 (inside Hakuba Highland Hotel)
activities.notes: Day-use onsen attached to Hakuba Highland Hotel, with arguably the best Alps views from any tub in the valley. Open 09:00–22:00.

activities.name: Hakuba Happo Onsen Obinata-no-Yu
activities.notes: Walk-in public bath in the heart of Happo Village with a small rotenburo. Convenient stop after a day on Happo-One.

activities.name: Hakuba Mountain Harbor
activities.address: 12056 Hokujo, Hakuba-mura, Kitaazumi-gun, Nagano 399-9301 (top of Iwatake Gondola)
activities.notes: Cantilevered viewing deck at the top of the Iwatake Gondola with a Hokkaido-based bakery (City Bakery) on site. Open both summer and winter.

activities.name: Evergreen Outdoor Center — Snowshoe Tour
activities.notes: English-speaking outdoor outfitter offering snowshoe tours, backcountry guides and avalanche courses. Excellent non-ski option for mixed groups.

activities.name: Hakuba Goryu Escal Plaza & Snowman Park
activities.notes: Snow play park and tubing area at the Goryu base with a separate non-skier entry. Good for families with small children.
